title: Measurement: the real start command runs the launch checks before anything starts, refuses an unavailable or unconsented selection by name, and holds Pi to what passed
summary: TSK-0037, toward ACC-0056 and ACC-0054, measured through the REAL COMMAND. The implementation is commit 4a3ebb7, and the sha256 of each file is in the facts. bin/start-kiln.mjs now runs checkLaunch before the supervisor starts anything, and puts what passed on Pi's own command line. WHAT THE COMMAND DOES. It parses --provider, --model and --thinking as the one-run override (each needs a value and may appear once), resolves the project root, and runs the launch checks with that override, a live-canary runner, and an ask only when stdin is a terminal. Pi's agent directory is deliberately NOT resolved first: resolving it loads Pi's SDK, whose bundled debug package enumerates the environment on load, and that is access this host has not yet allowed; the checks ask Pi for the directory only after consent passes. What passed is appended to Pi's argument list as --provider, --model and --thinking (withSelection), which refuses an argument list that already names a model and a selection with nothing usable in it. A refusal prints as a refusal, starts nothing and exits 2, through an exported exitOnFailure the capture fixture also uses, so the fixture ends the way the command does. HOW IT IS OBSERVED. test/fixtures/start-kiln/capture-launch.mjs runs the real main() in a child with the supervisor replaced by a recorder, and, with KILN_CAPTURE_REAL_CHECKS, the command's own checkLaunch. With KILN_CAPTURE_ACCESS the access recorder starts before main() and watches every auth.json and models.json by file name wherever they are, OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by name, and the network by refusal; the counts are written at process exit, whether the run launched or refused. The project is a real one: Kiln's ignore rules, a committed selection of a real catalogue model, this host's model-use grant, a stored key in an isolated Pi agent directory named by PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, and a compatibility record under the key computed from what Pi resolves. RESULTS. (1) ACCEPTED PATH: the checks pass and the supervisor is reached with Pi's argument list ending --provider openai --model <the catalogue model> --thinking off, and the command says compatibility was proved by this computer's record. THE POSITIVE CONTROL: the recorder saw Pi read its authentication store, and no network attempt. (2) ACC-0056, REMOVED MODEL: a recorded model absent from Pi's catalogue is refused naming openai and that id, saying no other model was used in its place, with both remedies, exit 2 and no supervisor. (3) ACC-0056, ABSENT AUTHENTICATION: an empty store and an empty OPENAI_API_KEY is refused naming the recorded ids, saying no other provider was used in its place, with both remedies, exit 2 and no supervisor. (4) ACC-0054, NO CONSENT: with this host's grant removed, the run is refused naming the recorded ids and saying no credential was read, with ZERO reads of any auth.json or models.json, zero credential-variable reads and no network — although OPENAI_API_KEY was set. (5) ACC-0056, MISMATCHED RECORD: a record whose key names another piVersion is refused naming the differing determinant, before the supervisor starts. (6) NON-INTERACTIVE OVERRIDE: --provider/--model/--thinking with no terminal is refused as unconfirmed, with zero credential access. (7) NO SELECTION: a project with no recorded selection is refused before anything starts, and no project state is created. (8) The checks receive the override, a canary runner, and no ask when the run cannot ask; a refusal from them reaches no supervisor and exits 2. LIMITS. D25: a custom provider cannot launch yet. The command supplies no custom credential declaration or provider configuration, so the credential contract refuses one; that input is still owed (D13, TSK-0060/TSK-0061). D24: the command checks project-local state only, matching the supervisor's current default. No billable provider was called: the accepted path is proved by the record, and the one-run override's live check was exercised at the component level (EVD-0130, EVD-0131), not through this command against a real provider. Setup (TSK-0060) still does not call the setup-side check, so a project's first record must be written by the component API. MUTATIONS, RUN LOCALLY ON WINDOWS. Twelve changes to the command and the checks each failed the tests: the checks skipped, Pi loaded before the checks, the registry read before consent, a credential read before an override is confirmed, Pi not held to the selection, an ask handed to a run that cannot ask, the override not passed, no canary runner, a launch refusal as a crash, a selection conflict allowed, an override flag repeated silently, and a mismatched record accepted. Each was restored byte-identical by sha256. CI. GitHub Actions run 35759728422 at 1087b30, which adds only plan files to 4a3ebb7, attempt 1 with no job re-run, passed in all four cells, and all 12 launch-path tests through the real command passed in every cell. The live compatibility tier ran in the ubuntu Node 24 cell and passed 6 of 6.
